name: user-token-auth
title: Add user-token (authorization_code) auth mode coexisting with enterprise token
description: Let pingcode CLI authenticate as the current human user via OAuth2 authorization_code flow (用户令牌), coexisting with the existing client_credentials enterprise token (企业令牌). Login chooses mode (default user token); authorization supports both browser redirect and manual code paste. User token carries refresh_token and attributes operations to the real user.
creator: epsilon
